title: pm-dispatch(reading-discipline): card threads read `os-dev.md` + the order, not the skill; seats read GitHub by named fields; fact tables by section
body:
domain:skills#1 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4cwTZvo7tAGwbbRW2b8

Filing gate: ③ 维护者直派 (pm rule change, filed because the maintainer named it). Priority p1 by the maintainer's word 「都是 p1」. Replaces #32847 Part 3 (one-page digest), which was not adopted: a digest is a third copy of the rules (「⛔ 不另抄」), drifts, and drops red lines.

Maintainer's words, verbatim (Elon, project thread 「评估车队如何节约 token」, 2026-11-12, UTC):
- 21:46:10Z 「任务很多，评估如何节约 token」
- 21:47:28Z his five measures: 「只在落地前合一次 main，中间不追」「只在设计、复读和红线检查时用 xhigh，写代码和修门禁降到 high，nit 继续用 medium」「把共用的部分压成一页摘要」「空闲的座位把巡逻间隔拉长，或者有新信件再唤醒」「互相依赖的卡串着做，不同时开」
- 21:50:27Z 「以上建议用 fable评审，然后立skills 卡优化」
- 21:54:51Z 「…按照你的意见补充立卡并全部交给 skills 车道 派发。都是 p1」
- 21:55:16Z 「32847 给你参考。冲突的话可以关闭 32847」

Measured spend (session usage readings, 2026-11-12): cache reads are 65–78% of every Opus session's cost, cache writes 11–25%, output 10–14%, so a session's cost ≈ context size × model calls. Seats reach 225–262k context within 15–40 min of seating; server seat 1 (11-05→06, 25 h) cost $272 with 521M cache-read tokens and a 347k peak. M cards cost $11.7–15.3, S cards $2.4. The proposals were reviewed read-only at the contract tier (`/mnt/project-files/token-savings/fable-review-2026-11-12.md` in the fleet project); this card carries the adopted form. Supersedes #32847, which is closed: its Part 2 had card threads switch effort mid-thread (a project thread's effort is fixed at spawn) and its Part 3 adds a third copy of the rules (「⛔ 不另抄」).

**Business reason.** A loaded document is not paid once: it is re-read on every later model call of the session. Seat rule reading is about 60k tokens, yet seats reach 225–262k within 15–40 min, so most of a seat's context is tool output (inferred from the readings). Halving resident context halves the per-call cost. Reader who acts: the `domain:skills` seat (os-dev on `references/**`; contract-tier review). Land this before the seat-context-cap card.

## Part 1 — a card thread does not read the skill (`dispatch-runbook.md:130`, `:143`)
Today 「开线程要重新克隆、重读技能与 `os-dev.md`」. Wanted: 「线程只读 `os-dev.md` 与派发令(及卡与全部评论),⛔ 不读 `SKILL.md`,references 按其指针按需读。」 The dispatch order already carries every seat-side fact the thread needs.

## Part 2 — fact tables by section (`reading-discipline.md:6`)
`platform-readings.md` is ~15k tokens and is read whole. Wanted: 「事实表做对应操作那一刻 grep 小节只读命中段,⛔ 不整读。」

## Part 3 — seats read GitHub by named fields (`reading-discipline.md:35`, read-order line, extended in place)
Wanted: 「巡查与探针读 GitHub 恒点名字段(`gh api --jq`),CI 日志落盘后 grep,⛔ 不把整份 issue/PR JSON 与评论全文拉进席位上下文;长线程照 runbook 外包。」 Scope: patrol and probe reads. A claim and a contract review still read the whole card/PR thread. ⛔ Not `board-snapshot.mjs` (archive-only by its header: "no seat, no patrol reads this"). CI logs: save then grep, never tail-only (`platform-readings.md` 「红检查先读日志」: tail returns only the teardown).

## Acceptance
- The three parts in the skill text, citing the maintainer's 2026-11-12 words.
- `pnpm check:pm-skill-ratchet` / `check:pm-skill-id-lint` green; reading-discipline (37) and dispatch-runbook (245) are at their ceilings: in-place rewrites or same-file deletions only, ⛔ no re-wrap.
- skip-changeset. Clause-②: no · Metadata-protocol: none.

Dedupe (open AND closed): `is:issue platform-readings in:title` → 72 hits, all fact-table content cards, none about how it is read; `is:issue "gh api" jq in:body patrol` → 1 hit #29386 (closed, unrelated); #32847 Part 3 (closed, superseded). **New.**
